risks.title: Hidden damp behind plaster
risks.cause: The room has an old external wall with no damp-proof course
risks.event: Damp is found when fittings are stripped
risks.effect: Wall repair needs extra drying time
risks.response: Take moisture readings during the survey and order a damp treatment kit in advance

risks.title: Electrical material delivery late
risks.cause: Cable and switchgear come from a single local supplier
risks.response: Add a late-delivery clause and get a quote from a second supplier

risks.title: Snags found at inspection
risks.cause: Benches and services are fitted by different crews
risks.event: Inspection finds misaligned benches and loose sockets
risks.response: Hold a joint check after each crew finishes
